rationale: The claim strictly bounds itself to EASA NPA 2025-07(B) as proposed material and a candidate lifecycle. Inspection of DS.AI.150, AMC1 AI.150, AMC2 AI.150, and DS.AI.160 confirms that the proposal spans operational domain/ODD, risk assessment, system development assurance, supervised learning assurance (recognising ED-324/ARP6983), lifecycle configuration data, and continuous in-service monitoring. No counterevidence contradicts this characterisation within its stated provisional and proposed scope.
evidence_locators: S-CHAL-002, PDF pp. 24–26 (DS.AI.150, AMC1 AI.150, AMC2 AI.150)
S-CHAL-002, PDF pp. 31–33 (GM1 AI.150, DS.AI.160, AMC1 AI.160(a))
limitations: Review is bounded to the consultation draft NPA 2025-07(B); it does not establish final AMC/GM adoption or whether subsequent comment-response decisions will modify the proposed objectives.
Proposed reliance on EUROCAE ED-324 / SAE ARP6983 remains subject to the finalisation and publication status of that standard.
